gate_decisions.notes: Ruled as the shakeout's delegated supervisor (uncounted, 2.0 charter). Approved: a feature in scope (backend/**, frontend/**) toward the PRD's Expansion Tier 1 (capacity limit per run). T1 (POST /runs echoes capacity), T2 (join at capacity -> 409 capacity_reached) and T3 (run-detail-capacity shows 'count / capacity joined') each fail on the baseline for a behavioural reason and pass on a correct candidate. Footprint is five product files plus test dirs; nothing frozen is touched; manifest delta additive; no retirements.

Task 2 (Package the build output for deployment): builder.assemble declares 'assembly_notes.md', which this increment's approved change does not touch.
